sloka: निर्जिता जीवलोकस्य तपसा भावितात्मना ।अगस्त्येन दुराधर्षा मुनिना दक्षिणेव दिक् ।। ६.११८.१४ ।।
transliteration: nirjitā jīvalokasya tapasā bhāvitātmanā ।agastyena durādharṣā muninā dakṣiṇeva dik ।। 6.118.14 ।।

translations.english: "Though the southern quarter is difficult to assail for the world of mortals, Agastya, a realized sage, has won by the power of his austerity. In the same way I have won you."
translations.hindi: उस शारोत्तम का धनुब पर सन्धान करते “भयभीत हो गए और प्रथिवी काँपने लगी
